description:
Researchers running heavy workloads need to choose SIMD targets, GPU offload and thread parallelism for their case.

## Background

Permanent pages target researchers evaluating or adopting gf2 and assume technical competence. Explanatory prose is freshly authored; only independently verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and empirical data are reused from prior material. Pages state current supported behavior only.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A page under `docs/how-to/` shows how to select and enable SIMD targets, HIP GPU offload and parallel execution for gf2-core and gf2-coding workloads, verified against current code, manifests and tests.
- [hard] REQ-02: Its prose and structure are freshly authored; reused items from `crates/gf2-coding/docs/SIMD_PERFORMANCE_GUIDE.md`, `PARALLELIZATION.md` and `LDPC_PERFORMANCE.md` are limited to verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and data.
- [hard] REQ-03: It contains no elementary primer, historical narration, migration language, speculation, future promise, marketing language or performance figure.
- [hard] REQ-04: Statements about relative speed link to anchors on the performance evidence page instead of stating figures.
- [hard] REQ-05: The page is listed in `docs/index.md`, and its links, anchors and citations resolve.
title: Write the acceleration selection how-to
